title: ITU space-station class codes (srv_cls.stn_cls) mapped to Table 21-4 service names

source.document: ITU BR IFIC (Space Services) Preface, Section IV, Table 3: Class of Station

notes: Telemetry, tracking and telecommand classes (ED, EK, ER) are mapped to space operation, but RR No. 1.23 says these functions 'will normally be provided within the service in which the space station is operating'. Against a row that does not list space operation they are therefore ambiguous, not a mismatch.
EW (generic EESS) cannot be told apart from active sensors, so it is ambiguous for rows limited to EESS (active).
Classes with no Table 21-4 service (amateur, radionavigation, standard frequency, time signal) never match a row.

E4.label: Space station in the Earth exploration-satellite (passive sensor)
